metadata.description: Official plugins and skills for bapbong, the .docx editor by Shadow Garden.

plugins.name: bapbong
plugins.description: Read, edit, create, search, move and delete .docx documents through the running bapbong app — the user's own editor, under the one permission they set for their workspace. Ships the bapbong command line (skill) and the bapbong MCP server.
